roadTrip.title: Great Ocean Road Loop

officialRoute.title: Visit Victoria — Great Southern Touring Route

roadTrip.summary: Leave Geelong Saturday morning, take Monday through Friday as vacation, and reach Melbourne the following Sunday evening. Keep the pace deliberate: ocean, rainforest, wildlife, volcanic landscape, mountains, one adventure activity, and a child-friendly historical finish.

plan: Follow the Great Ocean Road slowly and choose only two or three stops.
Reach Apollo Bay by late afternoon; explore the beach and have a simple dinner.
options: Fairhaven Beach and the Pole House exterior
Split Point Lighthouse at Aireys Inlet
Lunch and beach time in Lorne
Teddy’s Lookout or a short waterfall walk

days.route: Apollo Bay and the coastal Otways
plan: Choose one morning anchor: Wildlife Wonders, a surf lesson, or Marengo seal kayaking if ages and conditions permit.
Preferred combination: Wildlife Wonders and the easy 1 km Maits Rest rainforest circuit.
Choose one main activity: Otway Fly Treetop Walk, with ziplining if eligible, or Forrest mountain-bike hire.
Add only one or two short nature stops.
See the Twelve Apostles near sunset if weather and energy cooperate; otherwise save them for morning.
Start early for the Twelve Apostles, Gibson Steps if open and safe, and Loch Ard Gorge.
Choose London Bridge or the Bay of Islands, not every lookout.
At Tower Hill Wildlife Reserve, prefer the one-hour Aboriginal-guided wildlife and cultural walk; otherwise use an easy family loop.
Finish with dinner and a Port Fairy harbour walk.

plan: Choose the Griffiths Island lighthouse circuit or a shorter harbour, beach, and historic-town wander.
Stop in Dunkeld for lunch, the arboretum, and Mount Sturgeon and Mount Abrupt views.
Take the scenic southern Gariwerd road to a family cabin or glamping-style stay in Halls Gap.
Look for kangaroos and emus around dusk without feeding or approaching them.
Morning anchor: The Pinnacle from Sundial Carpark, 4.2 km return; allow about 2½ hours with children.
After lunch choose one low-key addition. The Pinnacle is the day’s accomplishment.
Book one half-day guided activity: beginner rock climbing, abseiling, canoeing, or a guided family hike; confirm minimum ages.
Use the other half for something gentle.
options: Brambuk and nearby walks, subject to reopening
Halls Gap Zoo in bad weather
Return to a favourite lookout for sunset

plan: Keep the Halls Gap morning unhurried.
Reach Ballarat by mid-afternoon and keep the rest of the day light ahead of Sovereign Hill.
options: A final wildflower or lookout stop

plan: Spend the full opening day at Sovereign Hill.
Prioritize gold panning, the gold-pour demonstration, costumed performances, rare trades, Red Hill Mine, and a prebooked underground mine tour if wanted.
Leave near closing, drive to Melbourne, and return the rental car that evening or the next morning.
